query:
SELECT i.id, i.inspectionType, i.status, p.completedInspections
FROM inspections i
JOIN projects p ON i.projectId = p.id
WHERE i.status = 'scheduled'
  AND p.completedInspections IS NOT NULL
  AND p.completedInspections != ''
LIMIT 50;
